overall_notes: This paper focuses on Training Data Attribution (TDA) methods for LLMs, specifically evaluating their ability to trace hallucinations back to training data. The NLG task is text summarization using the XSum dataset. Evaluation is done through automatic metrics (R@500 recall and AUC) rather than human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The paper introduces a novel method called DDA (Debias and Denoise Attribution) that improves upon existing TDA methods.
